cohort: Late preterm and term infants > 34 weeks of gestational age, discharged alive either from the post-natal ward or NICU at Nice Hospital for Women and Children, Hyderabad, India, excluding those with congenital anomalies, who died before discharge, and who were readmitted >28 days of age
finding: Poor weight gain, respiratory infection, jaundice, poor feeding/lethargy and feeding difficulty/vomiting were identified as reasons for readmission in late preterm and term infants.
